ucs.title: [LLM] Kimsuky spearphish: Hangul/Office macro spawning mshta/regsvr32 to fetch staged HTA from compromised KR/JP web infra
ucs.description: Hunts the Kimsuky (APT43 / Emerald Sleet / Velvet Chollima) signature chain where a spearphishing attachment (HWP, DOCX, or LNK delivered via ZIP) opened by Outlook/Word/Hangul spawns mshta.exe, regsvr32.exe, or wscript.exe within seconds and immediately reaches out to a remote HTA/SCT/JS payload. This combination — Office/HWP parent + script-host child + remote staging — is the most repeatable Kimsuky initial-access-to-execution chain observed by Mandiant, KISA, and Microsoft (Emerald Sleet) since 2020.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_hash) as hash values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("outlook.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","hwp.exe","hword.exe","hcell.exe","explorer.exe") Processes.process_name IN ("mshta.exe","regsvr32.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.user host | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where match(cmdline,"(?i)(https?://|\\\\[^\\s]+|scrobj|\\.hta|\\.sct|\\.js|/i:https?|/s:|-nop|-w hidden|frombase64string|downloadstring|wscript\\.shell)") | join type=inner dest [| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.dest_port IN (80,443,8080,8443) by All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.dest All_Traffic.dest_port All_Traffic.app | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)` | rename src as dest, dest as remote_ip | fields dest remote_ip dest_port] | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | table firstTime dest user parent_process_name process_name cmdline hash remote_ip dest_port
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let LureParents = dynamic(["outlook.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","hwp.exe","hword.exe","hcell.exe","explorer.exe"]);
let KimsukyScriptHosts = dynamic(["mshta.exe","regsvr32.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe"]);
let ScriptHostExec = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (LureParents)
    | where FileName in~ (KimsukyScriptHosts)
    // Kimsuky always uses an inline URL, scrobj COM, or a remote .hta/.sct fetch from the script-host cmdline
    | where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(https?://|scrobj\.dll|\.hta\b|\.sct\b|/i:https?|frombase64string|downloadstring|-nop|-w\s+hidden|wscript\.shell)"
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              Parent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              Child = FileName,
              ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              ChildSHA256 = SHA256,
              ChildPid = ProcessId;
ScriptHostExec
| join kind=inner (
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (KimsukyScriptHosts)
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, NetPid = InitiatingProcessId,
              RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort
  ) on DeviceId
| where NetPid == ChildPid and NetTime between (Timestamp .. Timestamp + 5m)
| project Timestamp, NetTime,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', NetTime, Timestamp),
          DeviceName, AccountName, Parent, Child, ChildCmd,
          RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort, ChildSHA256
| order by Timestamp desc

ucs.title: [LLM] Kimsuky/APT43 BabyShark/ReconShark persistence: Run-key autorun calling mshta/wscript with a remote URL and host recon batch
ucs.description: Hunts the post-exploitation host-survey + persistence behavior that Kimsuky's BabyShark/ReconShark/QuasarRAT loaders consistently exhibit: writing an HKCU\...\Run value pointing at mshta/wscript/powershell with a remote URL or staged script, immediately followed by lightweight recon (whoami, systeminfo, net user/group, tasklist, query session, ipconfig, reg query) collected to a staging file under %APPDATA%/%TEMP%/%PUBLIC%. KISA and S2W have repeatedly published this exact survey-bundle + Run-key combination for Kimsuky.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as runkey_time values(Registry.registry_path) as reg_path values(Registry.registry_value_name) as reg_value values(Registry.registry_value_data) as reg_data values(Registry.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Registry where Registry.registry_path IN ("*\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run\\*","*\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\RunOnce\\*") Registry.registry_value_data IN ("*mshta*","*wscript*","*cscript*","*powershell*","*regsvr32*","*.hta*","*.vbs*","*.js*") by Registry.dest Registry.registry_path Registry.registry_value_name Registry.registry_value_data Registry.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Registry)` | where match(reg_data,"(?i)(https?://|\\\\\\\\|\\.hta|/i:|frombase64string|downloadstring|%APPDATA%|%TEMP%|%PUBLIC%)") | join type=inner dest [| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count values(Processes.process) as recon_cmds from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("whoami.exe","systeminfo.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","tasklist.exe","query.exe","ipconfig.exe","reg.exe","nslookup.exe","arp.exe","route.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where parent_process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe") | stats values(recon_cmds) as recon_cmds dc(recon_cmds) as recon_distinct by dest | where recon_distinct >= 4] | table runkey_time dest user reg_path reg_value reg_data recon_cmds recon_distinct
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let RunKeys = dynamic([
    @"HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run",
    @"HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce",
    @"HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run",
    @"HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce"]);
let ReconBins = dynamic(["whoami.exe","systeminfo.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","tasklist.exe","query.exe","qwinsta.exe","ipconfig.exe","reg.exe","nslookup.exe","arp.exe","route.exe","hostname.exe","wmic.exe"]);
let RunKeyHits = DeviceRegistryEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("RegistryValueSet","RegistryKeyCreated")
    | where RegistryKey has_any (RunKeys)
    | where isnotempty(RegistryValueData)
    | where RegistryValueData matches regex @"(?i)(mshta|wscript|cscript|powershell|pwsh|regsvr32|\.hta\b|\.vbs\b|\.js\b)"
    // Kimsuky's BabyShark Run-keys almost always carry a URL, UNC, base64 blob, or staged-folder env-var
    | where RegistryValueData matches regex @"(?i)(https?://|\\\\[a-z0-9._-]+\\|/i:|frombase64string|downloadstring|%appdata%|%temp%|%public%|%programdata%)"
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | project RunKeyTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              User = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              RegistryKey, RegistryValueName, RegistryValueData,
              WriterProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              WriterCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let ReconBurst = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ (ReconBins)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","regsvr32.exe")
    | summarize ReconStart = min(Timestamp),
                ReconBinSet = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 32),
                ReconCmds = make_set(InitiatingProcessCommandLine, 16),
                DistinctRecon = dcount(InitiatingProcessFileName)
      by DeviceId, InitiatingProcessAccountName, bin(Timestamp, 10m)
    // Kimsuky/BabyShark survey bundle: whoami + systeminfo + net + tasklist + ipconfig in <10m
    | where DistinctRecon >= 4;
RunKeyHits
| join kind=inner ReconBurst on DeviceId
| where ReconStart between (RunKeyTime - 30m .. RunKeyTime + 30m)
| project RunKeyTime, ReconStart,
          DriftMin = datetime_diff('minute', ReconStart, RunKeyTime),
          DeviceName, User, InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          RegistryKey, RegistryValueName, RegistryValueData,
          WriterProc, WriterCmd,
          ReconBinSet, DistinctRecon, ReconCmds
| order by RunKeyTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let RunKeyRegex = @"(?i)\\(Software|SOFTWARE)\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run(Once)?\b";
let ReconBins = dynamic(["whoami.exe","systeminfo.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","tasklist.exe","query.exe","qwinsta.exe","ipconfig.exe","reg.exe","nslookup.exe","arp.exe","route.exe","hostname.exe","wmic.exe"]);
let RunKeyHits = Event
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where Source == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and EventID == 13
    | extend TargetObject  = tostring(parse_xml(EventData).EventData.Data[3]["#text"])
    | extend DetailsField  = tostring(parse_xml(EventData).EventData.Data[4]["#text"])
    | extend WriterImage   = tostring(parse_xml(EventData).EventData.Data[5]["#text"])
    | extend UserField     = tostring(parse_xml(EventData).EventData.Data[6]["#text"])
    | where TargetObject matches regex RunKeyRegex
    | where DetailsField matches regex @"(?i)(mshta|wscript|cscript|powershell|pwsh|regsvr32|\.hta\b|\.vbs\b|\.js\b)"
    | where DetailsField matches regex @"(?i)(https?://|\\\\[a-z0-9._-]+\\|/i:|FromBase64String|DownloadString|%APPDATA%|%TEMP%|%PUBLIC%|%PROGRAMDATA%)"
    | project RunKeyTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, UserField,
              TargetObject, DetailsField, WriterImage;
let ReconBurst = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend ChildLeaf  = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
    | extend ParentLeaf = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
    | where ChildLeaf in (ReconBins)
    | where ParentLeaf in ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","regsvr32.exe")
    | summarize ReconStart = min(TimeGenerated),
                ReconBinSet = make_set(ChildLeaf, 32),
                ReconCmds = make_set(CommandLine, 16),
                DistinctRecon = dcount(ChildLeaf)
      by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
    | where DistinctRecon >= 4;
RunKeyHits
| join kind=inner ReconBurst on Computer
| where ReconStart between (RunKeyTime - 30m .. RunKeyTime + 30m)
| project RunKeyTime, ReconStart,
          DriftMin = datetime_diff('minute', ReconStart, RunKeyTime),
          Computer, UserField, SubjectUserName,
          TargetObject, DetailsField, WriterImage,
          ReconBinSet, DistinctRecon, ReconCmds
| order by RunKeyTime desc

title: Kimsuky BabyShark Run-Key Persistence with Script Host and Remote URL
id: 7a2c1f3e-9d4b-4f1a-bc6f-3b8d2e9c7a51
status: experimental
description: Detects a Windows Run/RunOnce registry value being set with a payload referencing mshta/wscript/cscript/powershell/regsvr32 and a remote URL, UNC path, base64 blob, or staged-folder environment variable — the canonical BabyShark/ReconShark autorun pattern used by Kimsuky (APT43 / Emerald Sleet / Velvet Chollima).
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094/
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa20-301a
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/29
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1547.001
  - attack.g0094
logsource:
  category: registry_set
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_runkey:
    TargetObject|contains:
      - '\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\'
      - '\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce\'
  selection_payload:
    Details|contains:
      - 'mshta'
      - 'wscript'
      - 'cscript'
      - 'powershell'
      - 'pwsh'
      - 'regsvr32'
      - '.hta'
      - '.vbs'
      - '.js'
  selection_remote:
    Details|contains:
      - 'http://'
      - 'https://'
      - '\\\\'
      - '/i:'
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - '%APPDATA%'
      - '%TEMP%'
      - '%PUBLIC%'
      - '%PROGRAMDATA%'
  filter_machine_acct:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_runkey and selection_payload and selection_remote and not filter_machine_acct
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate vendor installers writing Run-keys that legitimately invoke scripts from %PROGRAMDATA% (suppress per vendor signing context)
level: high

| regex("(?i)(https?://|\\\\\\\\[a-z0-9._-]+\\\\|/i:|FromBase64String|DownloadString|%APPDATA%|%TEMP%|%PUBLIC%|%PROGRAMDATA%)", field=RegStringValue)
| join({#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/(whoami|systeminfo|net1?|tasklist|q(uery|winsta)|ipconfig|reg|nslookup|arp|route|hostname|wmic)\.exe$/i ParentBaseFileName=/(cmd|powershell|pwsh|mshta|wscript|cscript|regsvr32)\.exe$/i | groupBy([aid], function=[count(field=ImageFileName, distinct=true, as=DistinctRecon), collect(ImageFileName, multival=true), min(_time, as=ReconStart)]) | DistinctRecon >= 4}, field=aid, include=[DistinctRecon, ImageFileName, ReconStart])
